seoTitle: XML Sitemap Generator from a URL List
metaDescription: Turn up to 5,000 same-origin URLs into a downloadable XML sitemap.
intro: Turn up to 5,000 same-origin URLs into a downloadable XML sitemap.
aboutTitle: Which URLs belong in a sitemap?
about: Include the preferred URLs you want search engines to discover. Paste one complete URL per line from the same origin. The tool removes duplicate entries.
exampleTitle: Create a sitemap for a small site
example: Paste the homepage and a few published service pages. Download sitemap.xml, publish it and submit its public URL in Search Console.

faqs.question: Will this crawl my website or index the pages?
faqs.answer: The generator uses your pasted URL list. A published sitemap helps with discovery, and search engines decide which pages to index.
